sources.title: EPA’s Zeldin touts PFAS research ahead of 2029 water utility deadline
sources.excerpt: Administrator Lee Zeldin said the private sector is motivated to hone PFAS management offerings, which could bring down compliance costs for PFAS mitigation and spur more collaborations with EPA and university researchers.

title: Texas county sues to close WM landfill over alleged RCRA violations

sources.title: Texas county sues to close WM landfill over alleged RCRA violations
sources.excerpt: Harris County says USA Waste has failed to keep methane emissions at safe levels. The federal lawsuit, filed Tuesday, calls for the landfill to close and for WM to remediate the site, including its groundwater.
